questions.question: We use only 10% of our brains when learning.
questions.answer: False - Brain imaging studies show that we use all parts of our brain, even when at rest. Learning engages multiple areas of the brain.

questions.question: People learn best when taught in their preferred learning style (visual, auditory, kinesthetic).
questions.answer: False - Research shows that using multiple learning methods is more effective than relying on a single 'learning style.'

questions.question: Which of these skills is considered most important for the future workplace, according to World Economic Forum surveys?
Which country spends the highest % of GDP on education?
questions.answer: Cuba - Cuba invests around 12% of its GDP in education, one of the highest rates globally.

questions.question: How many hours of corporate training does the average employee receive per year (global average)?
In Hungary, over __% of adults aged 25–34 have completed higher education.
questions.answer: 39% - According to OECD data, around 39% of Hungarian adults in this age group have higher education degrees.

questions.question: Which country has the highest average student performance in math, reading, and science (PISA 2022)?
questions.answer: Singapore - Singapore consistently ranks #1 across all three subjects in the PISA assessments.

questions.question: Memory is like a recording that perfectly stores everything we learn.
questions.answer: False - Memory is reconstructive, meaning it changes over time and is influenced by emotions, experiences, and context.
